purpose: RESEARCH ONLY (owner decision 2026-10-20 §3, investigation B): IDP replacement anchors and league-specific IDP scoring.  No production code, value, weight, vote, curve, anchor or config changed; every alternative is shadow.

inputs.cardNote: both seasons are scored under the CURRENT (2026) card; 2025 was played under a different format, so 2025 here is 'this card applied to last season's stat lines', not what the league scored in 2025

consumers.what: anchor owner — best unrostered rankDerivedValue per position
ECC = max(0, base - waiver) x scarcity; unpriced base := waiver ('assumedWaiver')
cut ladder ordered by ECC (ties by name)
Trade Calculator / War Room / Finder / Angle capacity context builds the anchor
forced drop release_cost = base x scarcity (unpriced: waiver x scarcity)
forced_drop_cost (Team Context charge)

Analyze Trade objective value nets forced-drop release cost

Perfect Draft roster context: positional anchor + position-agnostic FA ladder
Perfect Draft client surplus = max(0, v*tilt - waiver(pos))
Perfect Draft client releaseCost = baseValue x scarcity
Droppability (roster intelligence) cut ladder
Perfect Waivers prices cuts with NO waiver anchor ({})
FAAB V_repl (position-agnostic: format line blended with live pool's 12th best)
FAAB route builds anchors
LI-5 replacement tiers (waiver tier only when free_agents are passed)
gameplan bundle calls LI-5 WITHOUT free_agents -> no waiver tier
scarcity multiplier reads waiver_scarcity only (inert 1.0 when None)

definitions.A0: served rule: best unrostered rankDerivedValue (snapshot rosters / live)
definitions.A1: best unrostered that is HEALTHY now under the shadow rule IA.is_healthy (NFL team, status not Inactive/IR/PUP, injury status not IR/Out/PUP/Doubtful/Sus/NA/DNR/COV; a missing status passes)
definitions.A1s/A3hs: A1 / A3h under the RECOMMENDED strict rule is_healthy_strict: NFL team AND explicit status 'Active' AND no unavailable injury designation; a missing or unrecognised status is unknown and excluded
definitions.A3: LI-5 banded waiver tier: mean of the top 3 unrostered (all / healthy)
definitions.A4: best-valued healthy unrostered whose season-to-date ppg >= P10 of the league's production-optimal starters at the position (A4b: P25 bar).  It uses weeks 1..N, the same data as the 'production starters below' metric, so that metric is circular for A4
definitions.A5: LI-5 roster tiers from shadow_replay (bestBallStarter = mean of the two lowest teams' marginal starters; starter = median marginal starter)
definitions.D: diagnostic: median value of rostered players producing within +-15% of the 3rd-best healthy free agent's ppg (the board's price of wire production)

Q2_availabilityEligibility.reading: best ball with no IR and no taxi: an injured player occupies one of 58 spots and scores 0 for as long as he is out; with daily waivers and a 1-day clear window almost every unrostered player is a free agent at any moment

valueVsCard_multiplicity.method: two-sided percentile-bootstrap p per cell (1,000 resamples, so p >= 0.001); Holm step-down across the family; Bonferroni interval at level 1 - 0.05/12
valueVsCard_multiplicity.outOfSampleCells: today_2026ytd and preseason_2026ytd; preseason_2025 is IN-sample (the 2026-08-25 board was built after the 2025 season it is compared with)
